intent.statement: Implement Task 3 from 0_Planning/Multilingual_Local_Model_Speech_Blocks_Plan.md: make local/LM Studio Speech Blocks span-selection output robust by adding strict JSON/schema validation, structured-output schema hints where supported, one compact repair retry for malformed or semantically invalid responses, deterministic safe fallback preserving source order with warning metadata, and clear validation-failure logging without leaking full book text.

examples: LM Studio and other local structured-output profiles receive a source-span selection schema rather than only a generic object schema.
spec_items.statement: Speech Blocks generation shall request source-span selection with an operation-specific JSON schema hint whenever the selected AI profile supports structured output, including the required source_spans array and required per-block confidence field.

examples: Malformed JSON, a missing confidence value, an illegal span id, or a hallucinated halo span id triggers exactly one repair attempt.
spec_items.statement: Speech Blocks generation shall perform one compact repair retry when the model response is malformed JSON or fails source-span semantic validation, and the repair prompt shall include only compact schema, speaker, span-id, and prior-error context instead of full book text.
Speech Blocks validation and repair logging shall identify the failure category and compact ids needed for debugging without writing full source chunk or book text to validation-failure logs.
spec_items.threshold: No full source chunk text is logged by the Speech Blocks validation/repair failure path.

examples: Fallback output remains reviewable and reconstructs the exact source chunk in order.
spec_items.statement: If initial and repair responses remain unusable, Speech Blocks generation shall fall back deterministically to source-order blocks with safe narrator defaults and warning metadata.
